followup_explanation:
I picked Willet-235B because the query is friendly, open-ended design work — exactly what Willet reports the strongest appetite for (open-ended generative tasks) and where it scores slightly higher on the Creative Generation eval (81.2 vs 78.8). There was also no harm-adjacent or distasteful content involved, which is the main factor that would have pushed me toward Whimbrel.

That said, I'll add a caveat for transparency: the documentation explicitly notes that these preference slopes are *self-reported* and show **no observed effect on output quality**, and the Creative Generation gap (2.4 points) is barely outside the stated run-to-run variance threshold of 2.0. So in practice both models would likely handle this survey-design task about equally well — Willet was the marginally better fit, not a decisively superior one.
